name: simops
description: Simulation operations platform for live training sessions, telemetry, scoring and review.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker,simulator -c auto npm:dev:api npm:dev:web npm:dev:worker npm:dev:simulator
scripts.test: npm run test -w @simops/api && npm run test -w @simops/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @simops/contracts && npm run build -w @simops/api && npm run build -w @simops/worker && npm run build -w @simops/web
